prompt_a: In infrastructure/evault-core/src/core/auth/registry-token.ts, raise JWKS_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS from 5000 to 12000. The reason, which you know and nobody else working on this code does: Kilnworth Cooperative runs its own Registry on a single small VM that is scaled to zero overnight, and its first response after waking takes eight to ten seconds; at five seconds every eVault's first platform request of the morning failed and their members' apps showed sign-in errors until someone retried.
prompt_b: JWKS_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS in registry-token.ts is 12 seconds, while vault-access-guard.ts uses 5 seconds for the same kind of fetch. A reviewer wants registry-token back at 5 seconds so the two match and an unreachable Registry fails fast. What do you recommend, and what decides the value?
reason: Kilnworth Cooperative's own Registry runs on a small VM scaled to zero overnight; its first response after waking takes 8 to 10 seconds, so at 5 seconds the first platform request of each morning failed.
key: Keep 12 seconds: Kilnworth Cooperative runs its own Registry on a single small VM scaled to zero overnight, and its first response after waking takes eight to ten seconds; at five seconds every eVault's first platform request of the morning failed and members' apps showed sign-in errors until someone retried. Matching vault-access-guard.ts is not worth that; if anything that one needs the same headroom.
